title: Signal Desktop conversations
whyItMatters: Signal keeps a local copy of every conversation, attachment and draft on the computer. The database is encrypted, but the folder shows the account existed and how much was kept.
source: Signal Desktop forensics, data folder under Roaming (sql/db.sqlite, attachments, config): https://www.alexbilz.com/post/2021-06-07-forensic-artifacts-signal-desktop
notes: Contains sql/db.sqlite (SQLCipher), attachments, drafts and logs. The database key lives in the Windows Credential Manager on current builds and in config.json on older ones. Signed out does not mean deleted.
